integrity: The arbitrary-length statement is proved algebraically from the published transition rules. The included exact-rational program checks representative finite-memory updates only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The total-variation bound is a sufficient uniform rate obtained from low-transmissibility blocks and is not asserted optimal. The proof assumes iid seasonal pairs as in the source and does not cover dependence between seasons. It does not address estimation of the low-transmissibility probability from data.
title: No-outbreak blocks remove the atom assumption and force uniform mixing
